features.title: We’ve got your back—fully
features.text: Our high backrest supports your neck, shoulders, and spine—so you can truly lean into your space.

features.title: Support that’s got your back
features.text: We designed Greta with enhanced lumbar support that gently cradles the curve of your lower back—so every sit feels naturally aligned and deeply relaxing.

features.title: Arms rest just right
features.text: Rounded and angled just enough, Greta’s arms follow the flow of your body for comfort that feels intentional.

features.title: Cushioning that responds with care
features.text: Filled with soft recron fibre, the backrest offers a light, buoyant feel that adapts to your shape. It gently hugs you without sinking too far—helping you feel weightless, not stuck.

features.title: Raised to simplify your routine
features.text: Elevated PVC legs keep things clean underneath and make movement a breeze when you’re resetting your space.

features.title: Upholstery that’s easy to live with
features.text: Our sofa is upholstered in high-quality synthetic leather that balances beauty with practicality. It resists spills, scuffs, and daily wear—so you can enjoy a sophisticated look without worrying about constant upkeep. Comfort shouldn’t come with conditions, and neither should style.
